Maya: Handoff — I'm primary for the 03/14 day shift (09:00-17:00 PT). Alex is secondary until 13:00 PT, Jon takes over after that. There's a planned lunch overlap 12:30-12:45 where coverage could be thin; if you're available please stand by to ack pages.

pagerbot: [ALERT] IN-2026-204 model-fallback-triggered — us-west-2 — active 21m — affected route: /v1/chat/generate — current fallback: redwood/rdw-small-quant — sev2.

Maya: Quick runbook pointers (use these first on a new page):
- If tail latency > 300ms or widespread 5xxs, follow Model-Fallback runbook.
  Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallback
- If you see repetitive egress failures or k/v mismatch, try KV cache eviction then rewarm:
  Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-evict
- GPU flakiness (OOMs, ECC, driver resets): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-health
- For customer impact assessments and incident status template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/customer-impact

Priya: Quick commands I use (paste into ops shell) — watch logs for errors and check pods:
```
# show recent 5xxs on the route
kubectl logs -l app=inference -n redwood --since=10m | grep "5.." | tail -n 50
# tail a specific worker
kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/inference-worker-1 -c inference -f
# evict KV cache for customer shard
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/api/kv/evict -d '{"shard":"cust-123"}'
```

Alex: If runbook step says swap to fallback model, prefer the verified fallback in the runbook. To rollback a recent routing change use deploy-bot:
```
# rollback routing rule
deploy-bot rollback routing-rule/2026-03-13-frontend
```

Maya: Escalation & paging rules:
- Pager primary first (this thread). If no ack in 10m, escalate to secondary. If still unacked after 15m, escalate to oncall lead + Eng SRE rotation.
- For SEV1 (customer-visible downtime) immediately call the phone bridge: +1-555-REDCALL (internal only) and ping #incidents.

Jon: Coverage note — I'm remote until 12:30 PT but reachable via phone. If you take over midday handoff, post "handoff accepted" with your name and ETA for full coverage.

Maya: Handoff checklist (short):
1) Confirm open incidents and owners
2) Confirm runbook links in incident channel
3) Check active autoscaling groups & capacity
4) Post customer impact short statement in #incidents if >1 customer affected

Maya: I'll handoff to Jon at 13:00 PT. Whoever accepts the lunch gap please post here. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: Reminder — next scheduled config deploy at 14:00 PT (canary). If you're on-call, be ready to abort if latency regresses.

Maya: TL;DR — runbooks: model-fallback, kv-evict, gpu-health, customer-impact. Primary: Maya. Secondary: Alex -> Jon. Coverage gap 12:30-12:45. Acknowledge here to confirm.
